versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Home Care Calendar.
- Guided 10-minute home inventory to log maintainable equipment and systems.
- Auto-generates a personalized, science-based seasonal maintenance calendar.
- Tracks completion, resets intervals from actual completion dates, and exports tasks to ICS for any calendar app.
- Estimates deferred-maintenance debt in dollars for overdue tasks.
- CLI tools for inventory, calendar views, marking completion, ICS export, and debt reporting.
